talents.name: Keen Mind
supplementalTables:
Raise your operators' trust to unlock more skills and profile data. Operators with higher trust also interact with you differently aboard Dijiang.
You can raise operator trust with gifts or by assigning them to the Dijiang Control Nexus.

levels.name: Friendly Presence - 1
levels.effect:
The battle skill Dolly Rush creates 3 Shadows of Mr. Dolly after hitting the enemy. The copies of Mr. Dolly scattered by the ultimate Wooly Party also have a 10% chance to create Shadows of Mr. Dolly when they fall to the ground. When the controlled operator touches a Shadow of Mr. Dolly, Ardelia restores the said operator’s HP by [45 + Will x 0.38].
If the controlled operator is already at max HP, then restore the HP of the teammate with the lowest percentage HP. Shadows of Mr. Dolly last for 10s and up to 10 can exist in the battlefield.
